Apply an appropriate amount to the affected area several times (a number of times) a day.
entries.1회 1포씩(15 mL), 1일 2~3회 원액 그대로 또는 소량의 물로: Rinse the mouth with 1 sachet (15 mL) per dose, 2 to 3 times a day, using it undiluted or diluted with a small amount of water. Do not use it continuously for 7 days or more without the guidance and supervision of a doctor. Increase or decrease the amount appropriately according to age and symptoms.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전에: Do not use this medicine in infants aged 30 months or younger. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced hypersensitivity to medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like), if you have an allergic constitution, if you have severe moist (damp) or eroded (macerated) skin, or if the user is a child. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only and do not take it internally. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water. If symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.과산화수소와 함께 사용하지 마십시오.클로르헥시딘, 설파디아진ㆍ은화합물,: Do not use it together with hydrogen peroxide. Consult a doctor or pharmacist when it is used together with chlorhexidine, sulfadiazine and silver compounds, alkalis, preparations containing mercury, or enzyme-based wound treatments.
entries.국소 알레르기, 접촉성 습진, 전신 알레르기, 광감작, 때때로 발진, 두: If local allergy, contact eczema, systemic allergy or photosensitisation occurs, or if hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash or hives occur occasionally, or if shock symptoms occur rarely (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not use it together with other disinfectants.
entries.드물게 쇽 (예: 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock occurs rarely (for example nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), or if hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash or hives occur occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitisation may occur.
entries.드물게 쇽 증상(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock symptoms occur rarely (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, seizures), or if hypersensitivity symptoms occur (occasionally rash, hives, itching or oedema), stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.드물게 쇽(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적: If shock occurs rarely (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness and the like), or if hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash or hives occur occasionally, or if a feeling of irritation occurs at high concentrations, or if photosensitisation occurs, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.드물게 쇽(예: 구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란,: If shock occurs rarely (for example nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness), or if hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash or hives occur occasionally, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Photosensitisation may occur.
entries.땀 분비의 감소가 일시적으로 자극감이나 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐)을 초래할: The reduction in sweating may temporarily cause a feeling of irritation or redness (congested and reddened skin); if these symptoms become severe, suspend use and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.매일 세 잔 이상 정기적 음주자가 이 약 또는 다른 해열진통제를 복용할: People who regularly drink three or more glasses of alcohol every day should consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking this medicine or other antipyretic analgesics. It may cause gastrointestinal bleeding.
entries.발진, 가려움증, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 종창(부기), 구진, 소수포(: If rash, itching, redness (congested and reddened skin), tumefaction (swelling), papules, vesicles (blisters) or excessive growth occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.설사, 스피부점막안증후군(스티븐스-존슨 증후군), 독성표피괴사용해(리엘증: If symptoms such as diarrhoea, mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), fever, erythema, itching or eye congestion are observed, or if rash and redness accompanied by high fever or burn-like oedema occurs, or occasionally rash or redness, or rarely shock, pallor of the face, coldness of the limbs, a drop in blood pressure, cyanosis, loss of consciousness or stomatitis, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.쇽(구역, 불쾌감, 식은땀, 어지러움, 답답함, 호흡곤란, 발적 등),: If shock (nausea, malaise, cold sweat, dizziness, chest tightness, difficulty breathing, redness and the like), hypersensitivity (occasionally hypersensitivity symptoms such as rash or hives, and a feeling of irritation at high concentrations), or photosensitisation occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.아미노글루코사이드계 항생제 및 바시트라신에 과민증, 고막 천공(뚫림)이: Patients with hypersensitivity to aminoglycoside antibiotics or to bacitracin and patients with perforation of the eardrum must not use this medicine. Use it externally only. Do not use it for a long period on extensive burns or on ulcerated skin. If symptoms do not improve after 2 weeks or more of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it ophthalmically.
entries.요오드에 과민증 환자, 갑상선 기능 이상(특히 결절성 갑상선종, 지방병성: Patients with hypersensitivity to iodine, patients with thyroid dysfunction (especially nodular goitre, endemic goitre, Hashimoto's thyroiditis and the like), dermatitis herpetiformis, renal failure or serious illness (such as burn patients), women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women must not use this medicine. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. Do not use it ophthalmically or internally. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. Do not mix it with other preparations.
entries.원액으로 사용합니다.이 약은 다음과 같은 순서대로 사용합니다.의료기구를: Use it as the undiluted solution. Use this medicine in the following order. Immerse the medical instruments completely in the disinfectant solution for about 1 minute (within 5 minutes). For instruments with fine pores, such as endoscopes, take care to ensure sufficient contact. After thorough immersion, remove the items and rinse them under running sterile purified water for at least 15 seconds, or with water according to the purpose of use. For instruments with fine pores or a complex structure the disinfectant solution tends to remain inside, so rinse thoroughly by pressure-injecting sterile purified water or water, or by extending the rinsing time.
entries.이 약 또는 기타의 인도메타신 제제에 과민증 또는 경험자, 아스피린 또는: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or to other indometacin preparations or anyone who has experienced it, anyone who has experienced asthma, bronchospasm, rhinitis or angioedema when taking aspirin or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, children under 11 years of age, and pregnant women in the 3rd trimester of pregnancy must not use this medicine. Do not use it around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on skin with lesions (haemorrhagic skin disease, eczema, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like, infected lesions, burns, wounded areas and the like), on athlete's foot, ringworm and the like, or on suppurating areas. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the 1st and 2nd trimesters of pregnancy), breastfeeding women, people with an allergic constitution, anyone who has experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines, and patients with bronchial asthma or psoriasis should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with a sufficient amount of water. Wash your hands after using this medicine. Use it externally only. Do not use more than 50 g in 1 week. Do not use an occlusive dressing.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자, 뇌, 척수, 귀, 질, 방광 구강 등의 점막면,: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, ear, vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, on the eyes, or on eroded (macerated) or suppurating (festering) areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have hypersensitivity to other medicines, if you are a patient with an allergic disease such as asthma or a history or family history of one, if you are a woman who is pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 경험자는 사용하지 마십시오.다른 약물에 과민증 환자, 천: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it. Use this medicine externally only; do not take it orally and do not inject it. Contact with the eyes may cause serious corneal damage that can require a corneal transplant (corneal erosion, epithelial defect / corneal damage, severe permanent visual impairment), so take care to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Anions contained in saline and similar solutions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.

entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.12시간 이내 면도한: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Before using this medicine, pregnant women, breastfeeding women and children (aged 12 years or younger) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it only on the area to be treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, nostrils, mouth or other mucous membranes. If accidental contact occurs, wash it off thoroughly with water. When a breastfeeding woman uses it, take care that this medicine does not touch the breast area. If it does, wash off every trace of the medicine thoroughly, however small, before starting to breastfeed. To avoid a burning sensation of the skin, dry the treatment area completely before using this medicine. Avoid direct contact with clothing, jewellery and polished metal surfaces.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약은 12시간 이내: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not use this medicine on skin shaved within the previous 12 hours, on damaged or irritated skin, or on the eyes, nostrils, mouth or other mucous membranes; if it accidentally contacts the eyes or other mucous membranes, wash it off thoroughly with water. Depilatories must not be used on the affected area within 12 hours before or after using this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant women, breastfeeding women and children aged 12 years or younger should consult a doctor or pharmacist before use. This medicine reacts with water to produce hydrochloric acid, so dry the treatment area completely before using it in order to avoid a burning sensation of the skin. Use it only on the area to be treated.
This medicine is used for hyperhidrosis, in which excessive sweating occurs in the armpits, hands and feet.

entries.이 약은 베임, 창상, 화상에 의한 감염증 예방 및 통증완화에 사용합니다: This medicine is used to prevent infection and relieve pain caused by cuts, wounds and burns.
entries.이 약은 손 및 피부의 소독(보건위생종사자 및 수술 시 수술자의 손 소독: This medicine is used for disinfection of the hands and skin (excluding hand disinfection of health and hygiene workers and of the operator during surgery, and disinfection of the skin at the surgical site), disinfection of medical devices, disinfection of furniture and instruments, and disinfection of wounded areas of the skin.
This medicine is used for hand disinfection of the operator and of health and hygiene workers during surgery.
This medicine is used for disinfection of the skin before surgery.
This medicine is used for the chemical sterilisation and bactericidal disinfection of medical instruments.
entries.이 약은 자바라관, 실리콘 튜브, 비닐 튜브, 실리콘캡, 실리콘 마개,: This medicine is used for the bactericidal disinfection of corrugated tubing, silicone tubes, vinyl tubes, silicone caps, silicone stoppers, scalpel handles and endoscopes.
entries.이 약은 항균 피부 세정제로서, 일반 피부 및 상처부위 세정, 수술 시: This medicine is an antibacterial skin cleanser used for general cleansing of the skin and wounded areas, hand disinfection during surgery, personal hand disinfection, and disinfection of the skin at the surgical site before surgery.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 약 또는 화장품에 알레르기 증상(발진, 발적, 가: Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like), if you have an allergic constitution, or if the affected area is extensive with severe wounds or severe burns. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. If it gets into the eyes, rinse them immediately with cold water and then consult a doctor. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only and do not take it internally. entries.이 약의 소독액 조제는 1제와 2제를 400:9 비율로 혼합하여 사용합니: To prepare the disinfectant solution of this medicine, mix agent 1 and agent 2 in a ratio of 400:9. First, immerse the pre-cleaned medical instruments completely in the prepared disinfectant solution, and for instruments and machinery with fine pores or a complex structure, use pressure injection or suction so that they are thoroughly wetted with the prepared disinfectant solution. Perform a leak test first if necessary. Immerse completely for at least 5 minutes, or for at least 10 minutes if sporicidal action is required. After thorough immersion, remove the items and rinse them under running sterile purified water for at least 15 seconds, or with water according to the purpose of use. For instruments with fine pores or a complex structure the disinfectant solution tends to remain inside, so rinse thoroughly by pressure-injecting sterile purified water or water, or by extending the rinsing time. After disinfection of the medical instruments is complete and before the instruments are used, always check for residues of this medicine using a hydrogen peroxide residue test strip or similar and confirm that the level is below 0.5 ppm as hydrogen peroxide.
entries.인체에 사용하지 마십시오.피부에 닿았을 경우 즉시 오염된 의복 등을 벗고: Do not use it on the human body. If it comes into contact with the skin, immediately remove the contaminated clothing and wash the area thoroughly with running water. If it gets into the eyes, immediately rinse them with running water for at least 15 minutes and obtain examination by an ophthalmologist. If the vapour is inhaled, move immediately to a place with fresh air and consult a specialist. When using and storing the activated solution, use a container with a lid or similar to prevent the vapour from spreading, and at the same time take care to ventilate the area. If necessary, consider using it inside a ventilation device. Take sufficient care in storage and handling so that it is not drunk or swallowed by mistake.
entries.일반 피부 및 피부 표면층보다 깊지 않은 상처부위 세정에는 세정할 부위를: For cleansing of general skin and of wounded areas no deeper than the surface layer of the skin, wet the area to be cleansed with water, apply the minimum needed for application to the skin or wound and wipe it off gently. Rinse thoroughly with water. Discard after a single use. For personal hand disinfection, wet the hands with water and rub vigorously for 15 seconds with 1 sheet of this product. Rinse with water and dry completely. Discard after a single use. For disinfection of the skin before surgery, use a sufficient number of sheets and rub the surgical site for at least 2 minutes. Dry with a sterile towel, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry with a sterile towel. Discard after a single use.
entries.자극감이나 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐)이 나타나는 경우 사용을 즉각 중지하고: If a feeling of irritation or redness (congested and reddened skin) occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Apply an appropriate amount to the application area in the evening and wash it off with water the next morning. Use it once every night until sweating (perspiration) stops, and reduce it to 1 to 2 times a week once the symptoms improve.

entries.클로르헥시딘에 과민증 경험자, 2개월 이하의 영아는 이 약을 사용하지 마: Do not use this medicine in anyone who has experienced hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine or in infants aged 2 months or younger. entries.특정 산화에틸렌 가스 멸균기*의 일회멸균공정마다 본제품 한개를 사용합니다: Use one unit of this product for each single sterilisation cycle of the specified ethylene oxide gas steriliser*. The ethylene oxide inside the sterilisation container vaporises to a concentration of 800 to 1,200 mg/L. This product is used specifically with the ethylene oxide gas sterilisation containers described below. (1) Steri Bag brand gas steriliser, type 400 B (2) Ethylene oxide gas steriliser (Steri Bag brand gas steriliser, type 400 C) (3) Steri Bag brand gas steriliser
entries.피부에 닿았을 경우 즉시 오염된 의복 등을 벗고, 흐르는 물로 충분히 씻: If it comes into contact with the skin, immediately remove the contaminated clothing and wash the area thoroughly with running water. If pain continues, obtain treatment from a dermatologist. If it gets into the eyes, immediately rinse them with running water for at least 15 minutes and obtain examination by an ophthalmologist. Delayed or insufficient rinsing may cause damage to the eyes. If the vapour is inhaled, move immediately to a place with fresh air and consult a specialist. If it is swallowed by mistake, immediately have the person drink a large amount of water or milk, do not force vomiting, and obtain examination by a specialist. Forced vomiting may cause damage to the respiratory system.
entries.희석하지 않고 바로 사용합니다.기타 자세한 사항은 허가사항 상세정보를 참: Use it directly without diluting it. For other details, refer to the detailed information in the approved labelling.
